discussion_comments.comment_body: `providerOverrides` comes from `settings.providerOverrides[provider]`, which is only written by `PUT /api/providers/[id]/overrides`. That route's `normalizeOverride` keeps `headers` and drops every other key, and nothing under `src/app` sends `timeoutMs`/`seatBudgetMs`. As things stand, `providerOverrides.timeoutMs` here and `providerOverrides.seatBudgetMs` on line 108 can only be set by hand-editing the DB, so the env var is the only working knob. I'd either extend `normalizeOverride` to accept and validate both numbers (finite, >= 0, with an upper bound), or drop the override reads from this PR so it doesn't advertise a setting that can't be saved.

Addressed in 06013c2. The wrapper now short-circuits when `NEXT_DIST_DIR` or `NEXT_TRACING_ROOT_MODE` is already set, so CLI packaging keeps its caller-provided sandbox/tracing environment instead of being overwritten.

Hardcoded model-routing regex — should use config constants.
Per `open-sse/AGENTS.md` : "NEVER hardcode values, models, or block/role strings — use config/ + schema/ constants."
These provider-detection rules should live in `open-sse/config/` (e.g. a zedProviderPatterns map in the Zed provider config), not inline in the translator.
